## Best age by current health state

This chart shows the best observed age group within each current health state. For each health state, the plotted point marks the age band with the highest symptom-free rate in the daily survey data.

```{python}
#| label: fig-age-health-state
#| fig-cap: "Best observed age group by current health state"
#| echo: false

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

vax = pd.read_csv("covid_vaccination.csv", low_memory=False)
daily = pd.read_csv("covid_daily_survey.csv", low_memory=False)

daily = daily[["VSAFE_SYSTEM_ID", "HAD_SYMPTOMS"]].copy()
daily["HAD_SYMPTOMS"] = daily["HAD_SYMPTOMS"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()

outcome = daily.groupby("VSAFE_SYSTEM_ID").agg(
  symptom_free=("HAD_SYMPTOMS", lambda values: int((values != "yes").all()))
).reset_index()

merged = outcome.merge(
  vax[["VSAFE_SYSTEM_ID", "age_at_vax_yrs", "CURRENT_STATE", "DOSE_NUMBER"]],
  on="VSAFE_SYSTEM_ID",
  how="inner",
)

age_order = ["0.5-04", "05-11", "12-19", "20-29", "30-39", "40-49", "50-59", "60-69", "70-79", "80+"]
age_midpoints = {
  "0.5-04": 2,
  "05-11": 8,
  "12-19": 15.5,
  "20-29": 24.5,
  "30-39": 34.5,
  "40-49": 44.5,
  "50-59": 54.5,
  "60-69": 64.5,
  "70-79": 74.5,
  "80+": 85,
}
state_order = ["Excellent", "Very good", "Good", "Fair", "Poor"]

merged = merged.dropna(subset=["age_at_vax_yrs", "CURRENT_STATE", "DOSE_NUMBER"])
merged = merged[merged["age_at_vax_yrs"] != "Invalid"].copy()
merged = merged[merged["DOSE_NUMBER"].isin(["First", "Second", "Third"])].copy()
merged = merged[merged["CURRENT_STATE"].isin(state_order)].copy()

summary = merged.groupby(["age_at_vax_yrs", "CURRENT_STATE"], observed=False)["symptom_free"].mean().reset_index()
summary["age_at_vax_yrs"] = pd.Categorical(summary["age_at_vax_yrs"], categories=age_order, ordered=True)
summary["CURRENT_STATE"] = pd.Categorical(summary["CURRENT_STATE"], categories=state_order, ordered=True)
summary = summary.sort_values(["age_at_vax_yrs", "CURRENT_STATE"])

best = summary.loc[summary.groupby("CURRENT_STATE")["symptom_free"].idxmax()].copy()
best = best.sort_values("CURRENT_STATE")
best["age_value"] = best["age_at_vax_yrs"].astype(str).map(age_midpoints)
best["symptom_free_pct"] = best["symptom_free"] * 100

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 6))
ax.scatter(best["CURRENT_STATE"].astype(str), best["age_value"], s=120, color="#2f6f9f")
for _, row in best.iterrows():
  ax.annotate(
    f"{row['age_at_vax_yrs']} ({row['symptom_free_pct']:.1f}%)",
    (str(row["CURRENT_STATE"]), row["age_value"]),
    textcoords="offset points",
    xytext=(0, 8),
    ha="center",
    fontsize=9,
  )

ax.set_xlabel("Current health state")
ax.set_ylabel("Age (years)")
ax.set_title("Best observed age group by current health state")
ax.set_yticks([age_midpoints[label] for label in age_order])
ax.set_yticklabels(age_order)
plt.xticks(rotation=20, ha="right")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

The label above each point shows the age band selected for that health state and its observed symptom-free rate. This is still an exploratory comparison based on reported symptoms rather than a causal estimate of vaccine timing.
